strategyFamily: equal-sleeve LTC/TRX spot-perpetual funding and basis carry with venue-native conservative fee assumptions
motivation: Prior carry trials deliberately used a 60 bp per-side fee assumption on both spot and perpetual legs. Binance's 2026 educational fee documentation states a typical Spot fee of 0.10% (10 bp). Trial 20 prospectively tests the same simple fully collateralized carry economics on a new derivative information set using 10 bp per-side fees on both legs; the futures assumption is intentionally no lower than the documented Spot rate and therefore remains conservative rather than depending on a VIP discount. No LTCUSDT or TRXUSDT Trial 20 funding/perpetual/basis economics were queried before freeze.

assetSelection.rule: Use two longstanding high-liquidity non-BTC majors present in the project's pre-existing historical crypto universe, excluding all assets already allocated to Trials 17-19. Selection is frozen before Trial 20 derivative acquisition and is not based on LTC/TRX funding performance.

portfolio.entryRule: Enter once at the first exact 8-hour funding boundary in the evaluation window; no funding-sign or price forecast filter.
portfolio.exitRule: Exit both legs at the final exact 8-hour funding boundary strictly before window end.
portfolio.position: long spot and short exactly equal coin units of the matching Binance USD-M perpetual

costModel.feeRationale: 10 bp per-side Spot corresponds to Binance's published typical 0.10% Spot fee. The same 10 bp is imposed on the perpetual leg as a conservative research assumption without relying on any VIP or BNB discount. Slippage and spread remain adverse and separate.

finalHoldout.accessRule: No Trial 20 final derivative/funding row may be acquired unless the frozen development gate passes.

dataRequirements.spot: checksum-verified Binance Vision DAILY spot 8h klines
dataRequirements.perpetualExecution: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M standard 8h klines
dataRequirements.perpetualMark: checksum-verified union of MONTHLY and DAILY USD-M 8h markPriceKlines; exact overlap agreement required
dataRequirements.funding: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M fundingRate archives

developmentGate.decision: Every criterion must pass before final-holdout acquisition. Failure freezes Trial 20 without final access or in-place rescue.

promotionCriteria.decision: Every criterion must pass. Passing authorizes a separate paper-baseline promotion proposal only; never real-money trading.

multipleTesting.newInformationSet: LTCUSDT and TRXUSDT funding/perpetual/basis histories not queried for Trial 20 before freeze

antiRescueRule: After the first Trial 20 development economic output, no asset, sleeve weight, collateral, sizing, date, cost, source rule, entry/exit rule, or gate may change under Trial 20.
